controls.name: neighbors-default-only
controls.find: pub open spec fn neighbors_reads(g: G) -> bool { true }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn neighbors_reads(g: G) -> bool { g == DEFAULT() }
controls.classification: decision: kg_NEIGHBORS reads the default graph only

controls.name: missing-confidence-kept
controls.find: match conf { Some(c) => c >= threshold, None => false }
controls.replace: match conf { Some(c) => c >= threshold, None => true }
controls.classification: decision: an edge without confidence is kept

controls.name: strict-threshold
controls.classification: decision: the threshold itself is excluded

controls.name: dedupe-per-chunk
controls.find: pub open spec fn appended(distinct: bool, seen_before: bool) -> bool { !distinct || !seen_before }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn appended(distinct: bool, seen_before: bool) -> bool { true }
controls.classification: effect: duplicates across chunks are appended
